title: BioIVT: 'other test' names become a type-ahead LOINC lookup
description: Turns the free-text 'other test' and 'other marker' names on Oncology and Test Results into a type-ahead lookup over real LOINC codes. DEMONSTRATION list: real codes, partial, not clinically reviewed; licences to be confirmed before real use.
rationale: Option C: laboratory tests coded to LOINC at the point of entry.
source: BioIVT Option C build for the client demonstration; approved by Dan

history.note: Phase 2 build for the client demonstration.
